transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been dealing with extremely high energy levels and intense mood swings for about a year and seven months now. My mood constantly shifts between feeling incredibly happy and euphoric, and then suddenly becoming extremely irritable over the smallest things. It has been really difficult to manage this constant roller coaster.
During these periods of high energy, or even when your mood feels completely normal, have you ever heard voices, seen things others couldn't, or held beliefs that others found unusual?
No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that weren't actually there. I also haven't held any unusual or strange beliefs. It has really just been the extreme shifts in my mood and energy.
During these periods of extremely high energy, did they ever cause major disruptions in your work or relationships, or did you ever need to be hospitalized because of them?
No, I have never been hospitalized because of this. As for my work or relationships, I'm not really sure if it has caused any major disruptions.

When you have these periods of high energy and happy or irritable mood, how long do they typically last at one time? Do they last for at least a week, or are they usually shorter, like just a few days?

They aren't short-lived at all and don't just last for a few days or a week. These feelings of high energy and shifting moods have actually been going on continuously for about a year and seven months now. It has pretty much been constant without any real break.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt very down, depressed, or lost interest in almost all activities?
No, I haven't really experienced times of feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in my usual activities. It has pretty much just been the high energy and mood swings the entire time.
During these times of high energy, do you notice that you need much less sleep than usual, such as feeling fully rested after only a few hours?
I haven't really noticed needing less sleep, to be honest. I'm not quite sure about my sleep patterns because it's not something I've paid much attention to lately.
During these times of high energy, do you find that your thoughts are racing or that you are talking much faster than usual?
I haven't really noticed my thoughts racing or felt like I'm talking faster than usual. Everything seems to move at a pretty normal pace in my head, even when my energy is really high.
During these times of high energy, do you find yourself taking on many more projects than usual, or doing things that are risky or impulsive, like spending a lot of money?

Yes, when my energy is high, I definitely take on many more projects than usual and start multiple activities at once at work and in my daily life. However, I haven't really experienced or noticed engaging in any risky or impulsive behaviors like excessive spending.
During these high-energy times, do you feel an unusually strong sense of self-confidence, or feel like you have special abilities or are more important than usual?

No, I don't feel like I have any special abilities or that I'm unusually important. I just feel extremely energized and active, like I have an endless amount of physical and mental energy to keep doing things.
During these times of high energy, do you find that your attention is easily pulled away by unimportant things around you?
I haven't really noticed my attention getting easily distracted during these times. Even when my energy is very high, I don't think I get pulled away by unimportant things around me.
